meta.title: Telos — a quiet to-do list
meta.description: A fast, quiet to-do list with due dates, repeating tasks and a today view. Everything stays on your device.

composer.label: New task
composer.placeholder: What needs to happen? Try “pay rent friday”
composer.hint: Enter to add · Esc to clear

search.label: Search tasks
search.count: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}

list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No tasks} one {# task} other {# tasks}}

sort.label: Order
sort.manualHint: Manual order — drag a row to move it.

summary.dueToday: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing due today} one {# task due today} other {# tasks due today}}
summary.thisWeek: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing left this week} one {# task this week} other {# tasks this week}}
summary.doneCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing done yet} one {# task done} other {# tasks done}}

task.overdueBy: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

toast.cleared: {count, plural, one {# finished task cleared} other {# finished tasks cleared}}

sync.title: Sync
sync.blurb: Optional. Sign in to keep the same list on every device. Everything still works offline.
sync.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
sync.statusPending: {count, plural, one {# change waiting} other {# changes waiting}}
sync.errorExists: That account already exists — sign in instead.
sync.errorConfirm: Account created — check your email to confirm, then sign in.
sync.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach sync. Your changes are saved here.

backup.title: Backup
backup.blurb: Move this list as a JSON file.
backup.imported: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new in that file} one {# task imported} other {# tasks imported}}
backup.invalid: That file isn't a Telos backup.

empty.todayBody: Overdue tasks would show up here too.
empty.weekBody: Nothing is due in the next seven days.
empty.allBody: Add one above — it saves on this device.
empty.doneBody: Tick a task and it lands here.

storage.errorBody: Your browser blocked local storage. Private windows often do. You can keep working, but nothing will survive a reload.

calendar.label: Month calendar
calendar.day: Day {day}: {count, plural, =0 {nothing due} one {# task} other {# tasks}}

stats.label: Completed in the last seven days
stats.streak: {count, plural, one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}
stats.habit: {count, plural, one {# in a row} other {# in a row}}

focus.label: Focus timer
focus.rounds: {count, plural, =0 {No rounds yet} one {# round} other {# rounds}}

bulk.label: Bulk edit command
bulk.applied: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing matched} one {# task updated} other {# tasks updated}}
bulk.unknown: I didn’t understand that — try “move work to next week”.

templates.title: Templates
templates.blurb: Save the shape of a task and use it again.
templates.saveLabel: Save this list as a template
templates.statusCount: {count, plural, =0 {No templates} one {# template} other {# templates}}

share.title: Share “{list}”
share.blurb: Anyone with the code can join this list, once you are signed in for sync.
share.statusCount: {count, plural, =0 {No invites} one {# invite} other {# invites}}
share.unavailable: Sign in for sync first — sharing needs an account.
share.error: That did not work. Check the code and try again.
share.linkCopied: Link copied — it opens the list without an account.
share.linkTooBig: This list is too big for a link. Share a smaller one, or invite instead.

review.title: Review
review.blurb: Your last seven days, from the tasks on this device.
review.empty: Nothing finished in the last seven days. Tick one off and it lands here.
review.dayLabel: {date}: {count, plural, =0 {nothing finished} one {# finished} other {# finished}}

theme.title: Theme
theme.blurb: One palette for the whole list. Your pick follows your account.
theme.autoHint: Switches to the matching dark theme after 19:00, back at 07:00.
theme.saved: Every preset restyles the whole app — nothing is hard-coded.
